SEED = 42

# Data loading
def load_metadata(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    df = pd.DataFrame(data["images"])
    ann = pd.DataFrame(data["annotations"]).set_index("image_id")
    df = df.join(ann, on="id")
    df["filepath"] = df["file_name"].apply(
        lambda x: os.path.join("input/nybg2020/train", x)
    )
    return df


df = load_metadata("input/nybg2020/train/metadata.json")

# Stratified split
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(
    df, test_size=0.1, stratify=df["category_id"], random_state=SEED
)

# Augmentations
train_tfm = T.Compose(
    [
        T.RandomResizedCrop(IMG_SIZE, scale=(0.6, 1.0)),
        T.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        T.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2),
        T.RandomRotation(30),
        T.ToTensor(),
        T.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

val_tfm = T.Compose(
    [
        T.Resize(IMG_SIZE * 2),
        T.CenterCrop(IMG_SIZE),
        T.ToTensor(),
        T.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


class HerbariumDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, transform=None):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img = Image.open(row.filepath).convert("RGB")
        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)
        return img, row.category_id

weights = 1 / torch.tensor(counts, dtype=torch.float)
train_sampler = torch.utils.data.WeightedRandomSampler(
    weights[train_df.category_id], len(train_df)
)

train_ds = HerbariumDataset(train_df, train_tfm)
val_ds = HerbariumDataset(val_df, val_tfm)
train_loader = DataLoader(

    sampler=train_sampler,
